title: Ab Lysis Buffer Preparation
author: Colin Daniel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bft7jnrn
materials: On ice add protease and phosphotase inhibitors (Roche)

steps.title: Prepare antibody lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Make a lysis buffer containing 20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 50 mM NaCl, 0.5 % (v/v) Triton‑X100, 0.5 % (v/v) deoxycholate (DOC), 0.5 % (v/v) SDS, and 1 mM EDTA by mixing the reagents in water and adjusting to the final desired volume.

substeps.instruction: Measure and add 20 mM Tris (adjusted to pH 7.5) to a beaker.
Bring the solution to the final volume with distilled water and mix until all components are fully dissolved.
